title: Entry-Level Trim and Keyless Entry
summary: Feedback on this topic centers on entry-level trim positioning and keyless-entry features, with most fragments too brief or ambiguous to determine clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise strong safety equipment for an entry-level model and welcome features such as electric seats and keyless entry.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize the entry-level trim as feeling poor and requiring too many costly options to seem acceptable.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly mention the car being an entry-level model or refer to keyless entry issues too briefly to support a clear sentiment assignment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, limiting confidence in a more specific sentiment summary.
Some undetermined fragments hint at problems with keyless entry or convenience features, but the assigned sentiment does not allow treating them as explicit negative evidence.
The topic combines entry-level trim references with keyless-entry feature mentions, which are related but not always discussed together in the same way.
